name: Santosh Primary School
tagline: Building strong conceptual foundations in literacy and numeracy
description: At the primary level, learning transitions from play to structured intellectual inquiry. Students build communicative fluency in English and Kannada, master mathematical foundations, and study environmental sciences through direct observation.
highlights: Regular field trips and outdoor recreation

features.title: Inquiry-Led Classroom Learning
features.detail: Classrooms are airy and naturally lit, designed so teachers facilitate discussion rather than deliver monologue lectures.

features.title: Concrete Mathematical Thinking
features.detail: Arithmetic is taught using physical aids and practical problem-solving to eliminate math anxiety before it begins.

features.title: Moral Science & Character Formation
features.detail: Daily assemblies and value-based lessons emphasize honesty, mutual respect, discipline, and reverence for teachers and parents.

features.title: Outdoor Play & Physical Coordination
features.detail: Dedicated playground sessions every week foster teamwork, sportsmanship, and physical health across student cohorts.
